Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Deployable via vLLM (recommended, with an OpenAI-compatible server), SGLang, Transformers, llama.cpp (Unsloth GGUFs), Ollama and Mistral Vibe; the Mistral AI API is also available. Reasoning effort ('none' or 'high') is set per request. A SYSTEM_PROMPT.txt is loaded from the repo. Fine-tuning is supported via Axolotl and Unsloth.
